hints.title: Strong Pair Definition
hints.text: A pair (x, y) satisfies the condition if the absolute difference between x and y does not exceed min(x, y).

hints.title: Small Constraint Iteration
hints.text: Given n <= 50, test all pairs (x, y) with a nested iteration.

hints.title: Max Bitwise XOR
hints.text: Compute x ^ y for every valid pair and record the global maximum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize small input bounds for simple double loop.
